foundry_calls.text: Your blade opens its arm, but the ghoul doesn't stop. It bowls you off your feet and the world tilts sideways into black.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: You wake later by the cold press of stone. The ghoul is gone; your pack is lighter by a ration and a pouch of coins, but you're breathing. Barely. The crypt has let you off with a warning.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I stand my ground and swing at the ghoul.
